case: Custom enum ORDER BY follows declared catalog order, not lexical text order
contract: A custom enum declared in zulu, alpha, middle order yields that same order from pg_enum.enumsortorder as the native ordering oracle.
A shuffled, duplicate and SQL NULL input result ordered by the enum column preserves PostgreSQL's declared enum order, duplicate rows and explicit NULLS LAST behavior.
pg_typeof and column metadata confirm every non-NULL sorted result remains the declared custom enum type.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres value_contract_custom_enum_order_uses_declared_catalog_order -- --ignored --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other enum operators, consumer formats and session/search_path combinations remain open.
